turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.

Hello, I can pass your tattoo booking request to a colleague who handles bookings. To start, please tell me the idea you have in mind, the size, where on the body you want it, and when you are available. A colleague will then take over.
The idea is a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of my left forearm. I can come on weekday evenings.

Thank you, I have noted: a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of your left forearm, available on weekday evenings. I am passing this to a colleague who handles tattoo bookings now. They will take it from here and I cannot give a price or a date myself.
That is the whole description I have.

Thank you, that is all I need. I am passing your tattoo booking request to a colleague now, with the idea, the size, the placement and your weekday evening availability. A colleague will take over from here.
